label: About
title: About The City Skips a Frame
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1415 recent saved-signal files and 876 captured links, then narrowed the page to 7 source windows around @gizakdag: I'm in love with this style --sref 496991497 and @mamosdigital: you got lost in a city at night in an old game, plus 5 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The City Skips a Frame: Portrait city photomontage: coral window slab and stepped masonry crowd the left; a needle tower stands across open electric-blue sky. One enlarged blue sedan with scarlet trim floats forward, its dark glazing holding dithered night depth. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 7 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Coral high-rise facade with dark window rows, Broad sedan windshield containing a nocturnal city, and Turquoise porch posts, railing and stepped entrance.

typography.rationale: Fraunces and Newsreader fit image-led art objects while Space Grotesk keeps process labels crisp.
